Uses narrative theory, dissonant and consonant narration, to show when the authors give conduct-book moral guidance and when they leave perspective ambiguous, engaging the debate over whether Austen was conservative or protofeminist alongside Wollstonecraft.

title: Hedgehog Signaling Pathway

title: Fatty Acids in Chitin
gloss: A soil biogeochemistry project testing whether fatty acids are covalently bound to chitin, the structural carbohydrate of fungal cell walls and arthropod exoskeletons, as a possible source of the non-extractable long-chain fatty acids that store carbon in soils. Chitin was solvent-extracted and repurified by methanesulfonic acid dissolution, then fatty acids quantified by GC-MS, in Neal Blair's lab.
